$about: The goal card's goals in order (yard-stage1.md 2.10, 5.3, 1.3, 1.4; ECONOMY.md E22, E25, E28; the lead's R20). Owner: hints. NO WORDS here: `text` is a goal.* key of src/engine/salvage/textKeys.ts, words in src/ui/salvage/strings.ts. The ORDER is data and belongs to the content engineer's numbers pass (content4; this order is the fourth pass's purchase order of proto/shop4.json, requests.md 16:08): reorder `goals` and `dayOne` freely; the screens and the rules read the order from here only. build-yard.py merges `goals`, `dayOne` and `teach` into games/scrap-yard/game.json `salvage` (keys beginning with $ are dropped).

$fields.id: stable id (saves keep the index; the rules map an old index by id)
$fields.text: goal.* text key (<= 30 characters in strings.ts)
$fields.target: where the chevron points: a map.points id, 'truck', 'advice' (the advice line's place) or null
$fields.via: a target the chevron points at FIRST while the boss is not driving ('truck' before a fetch goal), else null
$fields.done: the condition the rules read from the state (grammar in $done)
$fields.buy: the shop key the goal asks for (a purchase prompt: shown at most one a minute, 2.10), else null; an owned buy counts the goal done
$fields.optional: the card's Not now may skip it
$fields.stall: the gentle escalation after teach.stallS seconds without progress on this goal (one each; never a block, never a forced tap): ghost (the ghost thumb drags towards the target from the stick zone), stand (the ghost thumb lifts: let go and stand still), open (a ring round the one button), chevron (the chevron shows and bounces), goal (a ring round the goal line); null none
$fields.after: dayOne only: a condition (same grammar) before which the goal is not offered (the Night watch after the first time away)

$done.cut:<obj>:<n>: n things of that object finished apart since the start (the boss or a cutter)
$done.weighIns:<n>: the boss's platform weigh-ins since the start
$done.made:<grade>: a machine's out tray received that grade
$done.hired:<role>:<n>: n crew of that role hired
$done.crewWeighIns:<role>:<n>: weigh-ins by crew of that role
$done.fetched:<partner>:<n>: skips from that partner tipped on the floor (P14: counted at the tip)
$done.bridged:<partner>:<n>: skips from that partner weighed over the weighbridge (on the truck, or tipped since; P14)
$done.charged:crucible: Take from bays on with grams reserved or in the pot
$done.visited:<point>: the boss stood within reach.place of the point once
$done.repeat: never done by itself: the goal names the advice line's purchase (goal.widen / goal.widenLevel with {item}) and is passed over once the goal after it is done; with no advice the card shows the goal after it

$teach: Seconds unless the name says otherwise. stallS: no progress on a goal this long plays its one escalation; nudgeS: how long it plays; chevronShowS: a new goal's chevron shows this long; chevronIdleS: the boss standing this long away from the target shows it; approachM / approachS: closer by this many metres within this many seconds counts as on the way (the chevron rests); nearM: within this of the target it rests; ghostDelayS: after the gate parts the ghost thumb waits this long; ghostLoopS: one drag of the ghost thumb; ghostPauseS: the pause between drags; openPulseS: the first Open at a place rings this long; lessonQuietS: before this play second lessons print only on value jumps (4.4 item 5); jumpRatio: a value jump is a grade at least this many times the usual price of everything weighed before; autoplayReactS: the scripted thumb's reaction before every leg (the normal hand's 0.8 s, 8.2); autoplayStandS: how long it stands at a place before going on when nothing happens there (the stub rules).
